Just to the southwest of Eielson AFB, the fire has burned right to banks of the Tanana. Happily, the Tanana here is wide and braided. On the negative side, the fire is perfectly placed to provide bouts of smoke for Fairbanks-land until the snow flies: any wind direction except northeast will push into some part of the area.
